predictions.rationale: Provides a developer‐facing panel that listens to and displays ArgoUML event pump traffic, giving real-time tracing of internal events—core to the debug/trace logging feature.
Explicitly named *LogPanel* and intended to present the UndoManager event log to developers; offers detailed traces of user/command actions.
Wraps the core UndoManager and captures each undoable action, likely forwarding them to the UndoLogPanel or other debug outputs—key for internal event logging.
Displays and traces changes in the TargetManager (selection focus) which is useful for debugging; contributes to targeted debug output.
Catches uncaught AWT exceptions and typically logs stack traces; integral to runtime diagnostic logging and tracing.
Creates developer/debug actions that open various inspector/log panels, acting as the activation mechanism for logging features.
Registers the developer tools (including logging and trace panels) with the ArgoUML module loader, enabling the logging feature.
Builds tree nodes representing messages/events for display in developer views, supporting structured visualization of logged traces.
Generates caller lists in the developer browser, helping trace call chains—auxiliary support for detailed debug logging.
Inspects GEF modes and likely outputs their activity to assist in tracing user interaction, indirectly supporting the logging feature.
